items.title: Risky Chinese Electric Buses Spark Aussie Gov't Review
items.description: Deployed across Australia and Europe, China's electric buses are vulnerable to cybercriminals and sport a remote connection some worry the Chinese state could activate.

items.title: Okta SSO accounts targeted in vishing-based data theft attacks
items.description: Okta is warning about custom phishing kits built specifically for voice-based social engineering (vishing) attacks. BleepingComputer has learned that these kits are being used in active attacks to steal Okta SSO credentials for data theft. [...]

items.title: Fortinet Firewalls Hit With Malicious Configuration Changes
items.description: Automated infections of potentially fully patched FortiGate devices are allowing threat actors to steal firewall configuration files.

items.title: New Osiris Ransomware Using Wide Range of Living off the Land and Dual-use Tools in Attacks
items.description: A newly discovered ransomware family called Osiris launched attacks against a major food service company in Southeast Asia during November 2025. Security researchers have identified this threat as a completely new malware variant with no connection to an older ransomware family that shared the same name in 2016. items.title: Beware of PNB MetLife Payment Gateway that Steals Your Details and Direct to UPI Payments
items.description: A sophisticated phishing campaign targeting PNB MetLife insurance customers has surfaced, deceiving victims through fake payment gateway pages that steal personal information and redirect them to fraudulent UPI transactions. The scam exploits the trusted reputation of PNB MetLife by creating convincing mobile-optimized payment portals that mimic legitimate premium payment services. These…

items.title: From a Whisper to a Scream: Europe Frets About Overreliance on US Tech
items.description: Concern is growing across Europe about relying on US cybersecurity companies, and Greenland takeover talk is eroding trust across the EU even further.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-27843: Delta Electronics
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'kimiya' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-01-22, 10 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-04-22 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
